patch_description: Implement the recommended adaptive step control in the annealer: track acceptance rate over the last 200 proposals and adjust the step size to stay in the productive 15–50% acceptance band. This replaces the pure geometric step decay with feedback-driven control, keeping the search in the productive regime longer and improving the final minimum-triangle area. Also add a brief reheat schedule boost when acceptance collapses. The polish stage remains unchanged as a strict greedy improvement, so determinism is preserved.
